high_level_description: This image captures a striking natural phenomenon in the sky. The main focus is a large, dome-shaped cloud that appears to be illuminated with a rainbow-like spectrum of colors. This effect is likely caused by a type of optical phenomenon known as a "sun dog" or "circumhorizontal arc," which occurs when sunlight passes through ice crystals in high-altitude clouds. The cloud itself is situated above a dark silhouette of trees and vegetation, suggesting it is either early morning or late evening, as the light is low and the sky is a deep blue.
